Advanced AI Society launches agent verification standard as governance and control become critical infrastructure for agentic systems.

#1 — Advanced AI Society Joins Linux Foundation, Launches Open Verification Ecosystem as Congress Moves on Agent Security — The Manila Times / GlobeNewswire

★ Directly addresses agent verification and control standards—critical for enterprise AI governance in regulated industries where Eidosmedia operates, and for your board-reported AI-DLC programme.

Advanced AI Society and LF Decentralized Trust will co-host a public launch event on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, "Who's Watching the Machines? Launching Open Verification, the Proof-of-Control Standard for the Agentic Era." The standard addresses critical questions: as AI agents become more powerful and ubiquitous, knowing who they belong to and what they are authorized to do will be critical.
